stories.title: Theoretical model describes a new type of atomic oscillation with cloverleaf symmetry in altermagnets
stories.desc: A team of researchers at Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg (MLU) and the University of Münster has discovered a new type of atomic oscillation in altermagnets, which exhibit a striking cloverleaf symmetry. The findings were published in the journal Physical Review Letters.

stories.title: The Incredible, Elegant DNA Repair System Makes Gene Editing Work
stories.desc: Genetic information is sturdy, but its physical structure is sensitive. Natural tools for repairing a cell’s thousands of daily injuries are fundamental to gene-editing technologies. The post The Incredible, Elegant DNA Repair System Makes Gene Editing Work first appeared on Quanta Magazine

stories.title: Harnessing Glacial Lakes for Hydropower
stories.desc: As mountain glaciers retreat and glacial lakes grow, a new study looks at how excess water could generate renewable energy and help reduce flood risks.
